title: Hell Golf Canonical Representation
description: Rectangle grid with lakes (thick-bordered gray cells), balls (circled numbers), and goals (H marks). Board dimensions derive from the lakes grid. Ball count equals goal count. Player moves each ball onto a distinct goal.

lakes.description: height x width grid. 1 = lake cell (may not be stopped on), 0 = normal cell. Board dimensions derive from this array.

balls.description: List of balls. Each has 0-indexed position (r, c) and starting number n (>= 1).

goals.description: List of goal positions [r, c] (H marks). Must have the same length as balls.
